method: hardware execute breakpoints on the parkour selection routine 0x140133B00 (entry: candidate pointer array, first 16 elements x 672 bytes gathered) and its shared epilogue (EAX = selected index into the sorted array, or -1), decoded by tools/parkour_trace.py; clip starts from tools/native_probe/live_state.py (nominal 30 Hz) on the same QPC clock, as in tools/parkour_clip_pairs.py
time: t in seconds from each run's t0 (see run.t0). Scripted runs: the first input step; their QPC/Unix join uses the probe session (input times may be late by up to one poll, about 0.1 s)

decision_fields.thread: ordinal of the calling thread within the run
decision_fields.tester: ordinal of the first-argument object (parkour_trace.py 'tester') within the run
decision_fields.considered: indices into candidates of the gathered entry elements (at most 16), in array order
decision_fields.ranked: indices into candidates of the gathered exit elements, in array order (the sorted array)
decision_fields.selected_index: EAX at exit: index into the exit array, -1 = none
decision_fields.action_type: action type (fancy-table entry 0x45 immediate, ACU-RE-0042/0043) of the selected candidate
decision_fields.trial: [trial index, 'run' | 'settle'] for sweep/scan runs, null between trials
decision_fields.player: nearest live_state sample within 0.1 s: position, forward (heading = atan2(forward.y, forward.x)), sample_dt_s = sample time minus decision time
decision_fields.clips_after: [file_id, delay_s, weight] for every clip start within 1.5 s after a selecting decision (temporal association only)
decision_fields.selected_outside_gather: selected index beyond the 16 gathered elements
decision_fields.entry_missing: exit seen without its entry (considered unknown)

candidate_fields.action_type: int from fancy-table entry 0x45 ('mov eax, imm32; ret'); null if unresolved
candidate_fields.fitness: f32 at candidate +0x204 (read by the fitness getter, ACU-RE-0042)
candidate_fields.distance: f32 at candidate +0xC8 (read by the distance getter, ACU-RE-0042)
candidate_fields.unverified_acufixes_height_difference: f32 at candidate +0xC0; ACUFixes name, unverified
candidate_fields.unverified_acufixes_horizontal_differenc: f32 at candidate +0xC4; ACUFixes name, unverified
candidate_fields.float_format: shortest decimal that round-trips to the same f32

clip_name_source: local asset index (tools/asset_query.py where), first resource row; label/confidence as given
